__purpose: Processor node: while Push=true, repeatedly request screenshots from the selected client(s) at the configured speed, uploading images back to the manager.
label: Push Image Upload

metadata.description: Builds a client screenshot upload request. Display does not execute this client capture command.

compatibility.rule: Connect cmd output to Client Executor to request captures from selected clients.
compatibility.repairHint: If no image arrives, confirm the target Client supports capture and is connected through Client Loader -> Client Executor.

repairHints: Keep speed low enough to avoid flooding the Manager with uploads.
